title: Ek ghanti, saari yaad
banner:
Supplier ka paisa
yaad hi nahi raha 🔔
caption:
Kisi ka paisa dena bhool gaye hon, aisa aapke saath kab hua tha? 👇
ScoreMyBiz, 30 din muft: link in bio.
linkedin_text: A short illustrated story in Hindi about a mobile repair shop owner who misses a supplier's due date, then finds one in-app list behind a bell on the home screen with reminders, supplier-due notes and weekly check-ins. It is a list inside the app. ScoreMyBiz is free for 30 days on Google Play.

art.style: Warm hand-painted Indian storybook illustration, soft gouache and watercolour texture, golden-hour lighting, rich detailed everyday Indian settings, expressive faces, gentle nostalgic mood.

cast.Deepak: Deepak is a man of about thirty who runs a mobile repair shop, with short hair, a grey t-shirt and a small screwdriver in his shirt pocket.
cast.Gupta: Gupta is a parts supplier in his fifties with a round face, a cream safari suit and a leather bag.

scenes.vo: गुप्ता जी दुकान पर खड़े थे। और दीपक को कुछ याद नहीं था।
scenes.sub: Gupta ji dukaan par khade the. Aur Deepak ko kuch yaad nahi tha.
scenes.art: Gupta standing at the counter of a small mobile repair shop with his arms folded, Deepak looking up surprised from a phone he is repairing.

scenes.vo: पैसा देने की तारीख़ तीन दिन पहले निकल चुकी थी।
scenes.sub: Paisa dene ki taareekh teen din pehle nikal chuki thi.
scenes.art: Gupta showing a paper bill to Deepak, who scratches the back of his head.

scenes.vo: दीपक ने माफ़ी माँगी और पैसा दिया।
scenes.sub: Deepak ne maafi maangi aur paisa diya.
scenes.art: Deepak handing an envelope to Gupta with an apologetic face.

scenes.vo: पर शर्म पूरे दिन साथ रही।
scenes.sub: Par sharm poore din saath rahi.
scenes.art: Deepak sitting alone at his repair bench, a dismantled phone in front of him, looking thoughtful.

scenes.vo: बातें कई थीं। कहीं काग़ज़ पर, कहीं मैसेज में, कहीं दिमाग़ में।
scenes.sub: Baatein kai theen. Kaheen kaagaz par, kaheen message mein, kaheen dimaag mein.
scenes.art: A cluttered shop counter with sticky notes, a diary, bills and a phone with many messages.

scenes.vo: शाम को उसने स्कोर माय बिज़ के घर वाले पन्ने पर एक घंटी देखी।
scenes.sub: Shaam ko usne ScoreMyBiz ke ghar waale panne par ek ghanti dekhi.
scenes.art: Deepak looking closely at his phone in the evening light of the shop, curious.

scenes.vo: अंदर एक ही सूची थी। याद दिलाने वाली बातें, किसका पैसा कब देना है।
scenes.sub: Andar ek hi soochi thi. Yaad dilaane waali baatein, kiska paisa kab dena hai.

scenes.vo: हफ़्ते का हाल भी वहीं। जो नहीं पढ़ा, उस पर निशान।
scenes.sub: Hafte ka haal bhi waheen. Jo nahi padha, us par nishaan.

scenes.vo: अब वह सुबह दुकान खोलते ही घंटी देखता है।
scenes.sub: Ab woh subah dukaan kholte hi ghanti dekhta hai.
scenes.art: Deepak lifting the shop shutter in bright morning light with one hand, phone in the other.

scenes.vo: अगले महीने गुप्ता जी आए, तो लिफ़ाफ़ा तैयार था।
scenes.sub: Agle mahine Gupta ji aaye, toh lifaafa taiyaar tha.
scenes.art: Deepak handing an envelope to a smiling Gupta across the counter, both relaxed.

scenes.vo: गुप्ता जी बोले, अरे वाह, इस बार तारीख़ से पहले।
scenes.sub: Gupta ji bole, are waah, is baar taareekh se pehle.
scenes.art: Gupta laughing and patting Deepak on the shoulder.

scenes.vo: आपकी ज़रूरी बातें कितनी जगह बिखरी हैं?
scenes.sub: Aapki zaroori baatein kitni jagah bikhri hain?
scenes.art: Close-up of Deepak smiling at the viewer, shelves of phone covers softly blurred behind.

scenes.vo: स्कोर माय बिज़। तीस दिन मुफ़्त।
